description: This header file declares utility functions related to user and group information, such as obtaining group IDs from names, checking group membership, and retrieving user home directories.

methods.name: GroupIdFromName
methods.description: Returns the group ID corresponding to a given group name.

methods.name: InGroup
methods.description: Checks if the current user belongs to a specified group.

methods.name: SystemWideUserHome
methods.description: Retrieves the user's home directory as defined by the system, not relying on the HOME environment variable.
